title: Logistics, Supply, Fatigue, Reinforcement & Readiness
objective: Implement a bounded visibility-first deterministic logistics/supply/fatigue/reinforcement/readiness projection and owner-domain handoff contract over completed SCL-01..05 without duplicating Asset, Economy, Project/time, Character/Condition, Combat/Event or World truth.

allowed_sources: Character-Actors and Condition fatigue/exhaustion owner state
tranche_context.expansion_rule: No context expansion unless a named source is missing or contradictory, changed validation evidence identifies a concrete dependency, canonical authority drifts, or the owner explicitly requests expansion.

resolved_contract.supply_rule: Supply is explicit visible owner/profile evidence carrying D17 Asset/inventory/resource references. SCL-06 does not consume, transfer, reserve, price, settle, fabricate or infer quantity/capacity.
resolved_contract.repair_support_rule: Squad & Fleet source repair-support, Emergency Repairs, Repair Drone and post-combat repair-supply statements remain read-only support references/handoff candidates. SCL-06 restores no HP and mutates no damage; SCL-09 plus canonical Combat/Asset owners retain damage/recovery execution.
resolved_contract.resupply_rule: Source Support Action resupply is a read-only resource/Action handoff candidate only; no Asset transfer, resource consumption or Economy settlement occurs in SCL-06.
resolved_contract.fatigue_rule: The retained Squad & Fleet source supplies no general fatigue meter, threshold, accumulation, recovery or modifier formula. Character/Condition/profile owners remain canonical; SCL-06 exposes only explicit visible fatigue evidence state/provenance and invents no universal fatigue mechanic.
resolved_contract.reinforcement_rule: The source supports delayed reinforcements as scenario context but supplies no arrival formula. SCL-06 projects explicit visible reinforcement references and evidence state only; it never spawns units, advances time, selects arrival, inserts units into Combat or reveals hidden reinforcement existence/cardinality.
resolved_contract.readiness_rule: Reuse SCL-02 readiness labels unknown/unready/limited/ready. Readiness resolves only from explicit visible owner/profile evidence and is never auto-derived from supply, fatigue, reinforcement, morale, formation size or hidden evidence.
resolved_contract.owner_rule: D17 Asset/inventory, MIB-13 Economy, APW/D26 Project/campaign time, Character-Actors/Condition, A6 Action, A7 Combat, Event and World remain canonical and SCL-06 performs no owner mutation.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Permission/visibility filtering occurs before observation inclusion, readiness/fatigue/supply/reinforcement state, counts, summaries, search, provenance, deterministic receipts, handoffs or AI context. Hidden existence and cardinality remain undisclosed.
resolved_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Missing, unknown, conflicting or incompatible visible evidence remains conservative and is never auto-reconciled.
resolved_contract.determinism_rule: Stable record ids and explicit owner/profile/context/provenance/handoff references determine receipt ordering; presentation prose and hidden evidence are excluded.
resolved_contract.ai_rule: AI may advise only where separately governed. SCL-06 invokes no provider and grants no autonomous command, logistics allocation, reinforcement timing, adjudication, permission, owner mutation or completion authority.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable SCL-06 logistics/readiness ledger or migration. Migration 0022 remains unreserved.

acceptance_contract.red_rule: Acceptance/proof/profile/verifier land before production contract/panel and must establish genuine matching missing-production RED after invariants/install pass on both self-hosted lanes.
acceptance_contract.green_rule: Exactly one SCL-06 current-family profile passes exact-head repository health, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparison with zero historical predecessor fanout.

preserved_boundaries: D17 Asset/inventory, MIB-13 Economy, APW/D26 Project/time, Character-Actors/Condition, Action/Combat/Event, World and Permission/visibility remain canonical.

SCL-06 may project explicit logistics/readiness evidence and read-only repair/resupply/reinforcement handoffs but performs no owner mutation, resource transfer/consumption, HP repair, reinforcement arrival commit or readiness auto-derivation.
No owner mutation, AI autonomous command/adjudication, hidden-data reveal, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
SCL-07+, MAL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: Land acceptance/proof/profile/verifier first, establish genuine matching cross-platform RED, then add production contract/panel and carry exact-head GREEN through application merge, AIOC closeout and SCL-07 selection in this owner Continue.
